subject: math
title: Ratio, Proportion & Percentage
summary: One idea — comparing quantities by division — that powers rates, scaling, percentages, and most of physics and chemistry that follows.
outcomes: Express and simplify ratios, and recognise a ratio as a division comparison
Distinguish part-to-part from part-to-whole ratios and convert between them
Set up and solve proportions, including the unitary method and scaling
Move fluently between fractions, decimals and percentages
Compute percentage of a quantity, percentage change, and reverse-percentage problems
Recognise a rate as a ratio of unlike quantities (the bridge to speed, density, concentration)
